reason: I'd maybe self-host the open source version to poke at it, but I won't pay $99 for Cloud. My problem with background agents was never scheduling. It was that the PRs were junk, and a nicer pipeline doesn't prove it fixes that.
objection: Overnight PRs that pass checks can still be bad PRs. Pre-alpha from one developer, and a hosted server sitting near my team's agent logins, is two trust problems on top of a quality problem.
would_change_my_mind: Real merged-PR rates from teams like mine, showing most overnight PRs got merged with light review.
